body:
StableRTP is a high-performance Minecraft random teleport plugin that safely teleports players to optimized, lag-free locations while avoiding dangerous or invalid areas. It features smart location scanning, configurable cooldowns and delays, and a stable movement-check system for smooth and reliable RTP on any server.
